definitions.explanation: A label used in housing listings, hotels, and other facilities to indicate that pets are permitted. Very commonly seen in real estate advertisements and apartment search websites.

examples.japanese: ペット{可|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for a pet-friendly property.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ペット{可|か}です。
ペット{可|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。

notes:
A common real estate and hospitality term combining ⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧ (pet) and {可|か} (permitted/allowed). Frequently appears as a filter option on apartment search websites and in property listings. Note that even in ペット{可|か} buildings, there are often restrictions on pet size, number, or species.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペット{可|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: pet-friendly property
- ペット{可|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: pet-friendly apartment building
- ペット{可|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: pet-friendly hotel
- ペット{可|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧: pet-friendly rental

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: no pets allowed — the standard restriction in most Japanese apartments

RELATED HOUSING LISTING TERMS:
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with parking
- ⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧なし: no key money
- ⟦{敷金|しききん}→敷金：06079_shikikin⟧なし: no security deposit
- バストイレ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: separate bath and toilet
